name: Scheduler Reliability — Recovery Cron + Persistent Cache Ledger
description: ADR-0027 implementation: dual-cron (primary 08:08 JST + recovery 10:08 JST), GitHub Actions Cache persistent ledger with dual-stage upload (if:always()), and actions:write permission for cross-runner idempotency.

persistenceChanges.cacheType: GitHub Actions Cache (best-effort, 7-day TTL, ACID non-compliant)

guaranteeModel: at-most-once with bounded duplicate-containment, and at-least-once via dual-cron redundancy

residualRisks.T5: early crash before in_progress upload (very low) — irreducible
residualRisks.T7: same-day cache eviction (very low) — Phase 2: Artifact escalation
